[[Charmamani]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons/items.

==Dialogue==
:''"Ahai! What are you doing way out here? Me? I'm hunting [[giant]]s. Not that I'm very good at it. I'm an artist, you see, and I need their tusks. I'm trying to record [[Kormir]]'s victories, and the bravery of her [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]], of course, in scrimshaw. But there have been so many victories lately, I've ran out of tusks. If you could bring me 5 Giant Tusks, I can continue my work. I'll even give you something in exchange for them:"''
